objective: Preallocate Fusion storage SSTable file candidate lists for the first discovered SSTable file.

tasks.title: Preallocate SSTable file candidate list
tasks.result: Fusion storage startup now creates its SSTable file candidate list with capacity for the first discovered SSTable file.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The candidate list capacity is 1 because the first discovered .sst file is immediately pushed into the list.
The optimization only changes initial Vec allocation for SSTable file candidates; directory scanning, SSTable ID parsing, sorting, opening, and timestamp restore semantics are unchanged.
